other_mijikenda: Duruma: todza (for Heteropogon contortus, Pakia App. VI); also Swahili

teaser.en: The little black needles that cling to your trousers after a walk through any field.
teaser.sw: Vile vijiti vidogo vyeusi vinavyonasa kwenye suruali yako baada ya kutembea katika shamba lolote.
teaser.dg: Tembe ndide nyiru dza sindano, zinazogbwira suruwaleyo uchinyendeka kahi ya munda wowosi.

summary.en: Todza is blackjack, a common weed whose barbed black seeds hitch rides on clothing and animal fur. The Digo recognise it by its leaves and its seeds.
summary.sw: Todza ni kishonanguo, gugu la kawaida ambalo mbegu zake nyeusi zenye ndoano hujishikiza kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama na kusafiri nazo. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na mbegu zake.
summary.dg: Todza (kpwa Chingereza *blackjack*) ni mbondo ya kawaida, ambayo tembeze nyiru zenye viloo zinagbwira nguwo na nyere za nyama, na kutsukulwa phatu phanjina. Adigo anaimanya kpwa makodzage na tembeze.

about.en:
*Todza* is an upright annual herb, usually knee-high, with square stems and leaves divided into three to five toothed leaflets. The small flower heads have a yellow centre and sometimes a few short white petals.

The flower heads ripen into a spiky ball of narrow black seeds. Each one ends in two to four barbed prongs that hook into socks, trousers and fur. Pakia notes that it is one of the plants the Digo identify from its fruits, as well as its leaves.
about.sw:
*Todza* ni mmea wa msimu mmoja uliosimama wima, kwa kawaida hufika usawa wa goti, wenye mashina ya pembe nne na majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu hadi vitano vyenye meno. Vichwa vidogo vya maua vina kiini cha manjano na wakati mwingine petali chache fupi nyeupe.

Vichwa vya maua hukomaa na kuwa mpira wenye miiba wa mbegu nyembamba nyeusi. Kila mbegu huishia kwa ncha mbili hadi nne zenye ndoano zinazonasa kwenye soksi, suruali na manyoya. Pakia anaeleza kuwa ni mmoja wa mimea ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa matunda yake, pamoja na majani yake.
about.dg:
*Todza* ni mmea unaoima chocho, unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na kpwa kawaida urewe ni hadi magotini. Una mihi ya pembe nne na makodza ganayoganywa kukala makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano genye meno. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa vina kahi ya rangi ya mandano, na wakati wanjina vipande vichache vifupi vyereru vya ruwa.

Vitswa vya maruwa vichiivwa vinakala chitswa cha mviringo chenye miya, cha tembe nyiru nyembamba. Chila tembe inamala na ntsa mbiri hadi nne zenye viloo, zinazogbwira soksi, suruwale na nyere za nyama. Pakia anaandika kukala ni kahi ya mimea ambayo Adigo nkuimanya kpwa matundage, phamwenga na makodzage.

where.en: It is a weed of farms, gardens, roadsides and any disturbed ground throughout the coast and much of the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la mashamba, bustani, kando ya barabara na ardhi yoyote iliyochimbuliwa kote pwani na katika sehemu kubwa ya ukanda wa tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo ya mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na chila phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, pwani yosi na kpwenye tsi nyinji za dzoho za dunia.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. In much of East Africa the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable, and the plant is widely used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika Mashariki, majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga, na mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa. Kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika ya Mlairo, makodza maphya nkujitwa dza mtsunga, na mmea uhu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *todza* for blackjack, and the same name for spear grass (*Heteropogon contortus*), whose seeds also stick to clothing; for spear grass the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili. Pakia's name-prefix table also gives *nguji* for blackjack, though his plant list gives *nguji* for spear grass. In English it is blackjack or beggar's tick.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *todza* kwa kishonanguo, na jina hilohilo kwa nyasi-mkuki (*Heteropogon contortus*), ambayo mbegu zake pia hunata kwenye nguo; kwa nyasi-mkuki jina hili linatumika pia katika Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Jedwali la Pakia la viambishi vya majina pia linatoa *nguji* kwa kishonanguo, ingawa orodha yake ya mimea inatoa *nguji* kwa nyasi-mkuki. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *blackjack* au *beggar's tick*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *todza* kpwa mmea uhu, na dzina hiri hiri kpwa *nguji* (*Heteropogon contortus*, kpwa Chingereza *spear grass*), ambayo tembeze piya zinagbwira nguwo; kpwa *nguji*, dzina *todza* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. Orodha ya Pakia ya *prefix* za madzina piya inapha *nguji* kpwa mmea uhu, ela orodhaye ya mimea inapha *nguji* kpwa *Heteropogon contortus*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *blackjack* au *beggar's tick*.
